sources.title: What Are AI Checkpoints? Uses, Benefits & Sharing | WEKA
sources.snippet: What Is an AI Checkpoint? AI checkpoints are saved states of a machine learning model at a particular point in its training process. They usually include the model's parameters—weights and biases—and sometimes additional information, such as the optimizer state, epoch number, or training progress.
